limitations: Fresh unchanged authored worlds with disposable public-API edits; no installed infill source or saved-user-city mutation. Normal-game construction timing is not tested by paused Democity snapshots.
Terrain serialization is cloned but not returned: only a32-bit FNV digest and21 ground/road samples are saved. Matching digest and samples are not exact full-terrain byte proof.

CandidateRepeatExact compares the declared serialized projection, excluding versions/images; it is not visual, full-runtime, save-load or undo/redo determinism. Repeated post-commit corruption is still corruption.
Lot geometry restore compares planar descriptors/cells, excluding ID/edge ownership/y/t/building links; it does not establish full parcel or building identity restoration.

Original oneBuildingPerLot check only checks live-lot forward links. Revised offline audit catches missing-live-lot buildings but is not a universal inverse-injectivity test; critic additionally checked live inverse links and found no further mismatch in retained snapshots.

Road descriptor comparison ignores IDs and sorts endpoints, which is not a complete directional one-way/profile equivalence oracle. Actual retained failures are independently confirmed by elevation flags and road-surface heights.

Transit route IDs change after road regeneration; this alone is not broken transit. Every retained stop/route edge reference is live, line length unchanged across restoration. Height/headway differences and surface drift establish failure of exact derived restoration, not proven route outage.
Only selected economy fields are compared (money,population,jobs,net,demand,loans,taxRate); Services full serialized projection matches. No all-economy or Simulation full-state restore claim follows.
Capture settling is fixed90/120/30 rendered frames, not explicit camera-flight/owner-idle assertions. Screenshots have no retained actual camera matrices or per-image performance sidecars.

Candidate road panel obscures much of the scene, seed7 tower occludes part of the connector, and traffic/foliage/environment/UI vary. Whole-frame RGB differences are not road-only metrics or a visual-quality score.
No complete matrix, night/weather, forced-GC memory, performance, native pointer/keyboard, save-load or general-world correctness gate passes from this rejected round.
